raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Design-domain outline",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The Introduction points to Fig. 1(a), whose caption identifies the domain only by dark-gray coloring. Its outline and any geometric exclusions are not described.",
      "readings": [
        "The entire rectangular grid is the design domain.",
        "An L-shaped mask occupies the rectangular grid, with the upper-right quarter excluded."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "In-plane dimensions and aspect ratio",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Fig. 1 gives element counts but no physical dimensions or requirement that cells be square. Let W denote horizontal extent and H vertical extent.",
      "readings": [
        "W = 60 mm, H = 30 mm.",
        "W = 60 mm, H = 60 mm.",
        "W = 120 mm, H = 30 mm."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Assignment of mesh counts to coordinate directions",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The captions of Figs. 1 and 2 specify 30 by 60 elements without identifying which count is horizontal.",
      "readings": [
        "60 elements horizontally and 30 vertically.",
        "30 elements horizontally and 60 vertically."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Finite-element formulation and quadrature",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The text specifies finite elements and elementwise densities, but not displacement interpolation, element order, or integration.",
      "readings": [
        "Four-node bilinear quadrilaterals with full 2-by-2 Gauss integration.",
        "Four-node quadrilaterals with one-point integration and hourglass stabilization.",
        "Eight-node quadratic quadrilaterals with 3-by-3 Gauss integration."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial support of the lower-right load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Fig. 1 calls the load distributed but locates it at a corner, without specifying loaded nodes, the adjacent edge, or patch length. The downward direction and stated 1 N force are given.",
      "readings": [
        "A single downward nodal force of 1 N at the lower-right corner.",
        "A distributed force totaling 1 N over the bottom one-element segment of the right edge.",
        "A distributed force totaling 1 N over the lowest 10 percent of the right edge.",
        "A distributed force totaling 1 N over the rightmost one-element segment of the bottom edge."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Load profile and nodal assembly on a finite patch",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "For a finite loaded patch, Fig. 1 does not specify the traction profile or how its resultant is assigned to nodes.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform traction integrated using consistent finite-element nodal loads.",
        "Equal downward forces at all loaded boundary nodes, summing to 1 N.",
        "Linearly tapered traction, largest at the corner and zero at the other patch endpoint, totaling 1 N."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Prescribed solid regions near supports and loads",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither the Fig. 1 caption nor the structural setup states whether support or load-adjacent elements must remain solid.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive solid elements.",
        "A one-element-thick solid strip along the fixed left boundary.",
        "A 2-by-2-element solid pad at the lower-right load.",
        "Both the left solid strip and the lower-right solid pad."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Elastic constitutive symmetry and orientation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sections 2 and 3.1 specify linear elasticity but give no constitutive tensor. The Introduction mentions SIMP generically without explicitly assigning an isotropic material to Fig. 1.",
      "readings": [
        "Homogeneous isotropic elasticity.",
        "Homogeneous orthotropic elasticity with E_x = 2 E_y and material axes aligned with the grid.",
        "The same orthotropic material with its axes rotated by 90 degrees."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Two-dimensional elasticity assumption",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The example is called 2-D, but neither Fig. 1 nor the structural formulation specifies plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress.",
        "Plane strain."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Solid elastic stiffness scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No solid Young's modulus or equivalent common multiplier of the elastic tensor is supplied. A uniform stiffness rescaling preserves layout when dimensionless material parameters and stiffness contrast are held fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalized solid Young's modulus E0 = 1.",
        "E0 = 70 GPa.",
        "E0 = 210 GPa."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio under isotropic elasticity",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Poisson's ratio is given for the structural examples.",
      "readings": [
        "nu = 0.25.",
        "nu = 0.30.",
        "nu = 0.33."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Fig. 1 and the structural formulation do not give a thickness or explicitly adopt unit thickness. With a fixed resultant force, uniform thickness multiplies all element stiffnesses.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness t = 1 in the chosen length unit.",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.1 in that length unit.",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.01 in that length unit."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Density-to-stiffness interpolation and penalization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The Introduction presents SIMP as a general example; Eq. (13) leaves K(rho) unspecified. No interpolation law, stiffness penalty exponent, or continuation schedule is assigned to Fig. 1. The stated p = 10 concerns stress aggregation.",
      "readings": [
        "Linear stiffness interpolation, equivalent to a fixed SIMP exponent of 1.",
        "SIMP with a fixed stiffness exponent of 3.",
        "SIMP with a fixed stiffness exponent of 4.",
        "SIMP continuation: exponent 1 for 20 iterations, 2 for 20 iterations, then 3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Residual void stiffness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The stiffness matrix is not defined sufficiently to determine whether an additive minimum modulus is used or its ratio to solid stiffness.",
      "readings": [
        "No additive modulus floor; stiffness is regularized solely through the positive density lower bound.",
        "Modified SIMP with E_min/E0 = 1e-9.",
        "Modified SIMP with E_min/E0 = 1e-6."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density lower bound",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Section 2 gives approximately 1e-6 only as an example; Section 3.1 requires a small positive lower bound without fixing its value.",
      "readings": [
        "rho_min = 1e-6.",
        "rho_min = 1e-9.",
        "rho_min = 1e-3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Additional density projection",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Projection functions are discussed in the Introduction, but the text does not explicitly establish whether Fig. 1 uses only density filtering or also a projection.",
      "readings": [
        "No projection after density filtering.",
        "Smooth Heaviside projection with threshold 0.5 and fixed sharpness beta = 1.",
        "Smooth Heaviside projection with threshold 0.5 and sharpness continued from beta = 1 to beta = 8."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density-filter kernel",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Fig. 1 fixes the density-filter radius at 2.5 element sizes, but supplies no filter equation or weighting kernel.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalized linear-cone weights proportional to max(0, 2.5 - distance).",
        "Uniform weights for all element centers within radius 2.5.",
        "Gaussian weights with standard deviation one element size, truncated at radius 2.5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter distance and meaning of element size",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "For non-square cells, which the caption does not exclude, the phrase '2.5 (element size)' does not identify a physical length or distance convention.",
      "readings": [
        "Euclidean distance in element-index coordinates, with radius 2.5.",
        "Physical Euclidean distance, with radius 2.5 times the horizontal cell width.",
        "Physical Euclidean distance, with radius 2.5 times the vertical cell height."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Filter boundary treatment",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No handling of filter neighborhoods crossing the domain boundary or a domain mask is specified.",
      "readings": [
        "Discard outside-domain neighbors and renormalize the remaining weights.",
        "Treat outside-domain density as zero while retaining the full-kernel denominator.",
        "Extend the density field by reflection at the boundary."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Density field used to enforce the volume budget",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Eq. (13) writes the 0.5 budget using rho, while Section 3 says density filtering is applied to design variables. No separate raw and physical density notation identifies the implemented constraint field.",
      "readings": [
        "Enforce the 0.5 bound on unfiltered design densities.",
        "Enforce the 0.5 bound on filtered physical densities.",
        "If projection is used, enforce the 0.5 bound on projected physical densities."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "MMA move limit for Fig. 1",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Fig. 1 gives no move-limit value. Fig. 3 introduces a reduction after iteration five, and Section 3.1 explicitly assigns 0.2 to Fig. 10, without explicitly fixing the Fig. 1 baseline.",
      "readings": [
        "Constant move limit 0.1.",
        "Constant move limit 0.2.",
        "Constant move limit 0.3."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Remaining MMA parameters",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Appendix A identifies Svanberg's MMA code but does not supply asymptote initialization and update constants, subproblem penalties, or internal tolerances.",
      "readings": [
        "Initial asymptote half-width 0.5; expansion 1.2; contraction 0.7; constraint penalty c = 1000, d = 0; subproblem tolerance 1e-7.",
        "Initial asymptote half-width 0.1; expansion 1.05; contraction 0.9; constraint penalty c = 100, d = 0; subproblem tolerance 1e-6."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Scaling of quantities passed to MMA",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (13) defines the mathematical objective and constraint, but the implementation description does not specify their numerical normalization before MMA updates.",
      "readings": [
        "Pass compliance J and volume residual V - 0.5 directly.",
        "Pass J divided by initial compliance and normalized volume residual V/0.5 - 1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization stopping criterion",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Fig. 1 specifies a maximum of 100 iterations but does not state whether an earlier stopping test is used.",
      "readings": [
        "Always perform 100 iterations.",
        "Stop earlier when maximum element-density change falls below 0.01.",
        "Stop earlier when maximum element-density change falls below 0.001."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Numerical equilibrium solve",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sections 2 and 3.1 state K u = f, but Appendix A gives no linear-solver method or equilibrium tolerance needed for exact numerical reproduction.",
      "readings": [
        "Sparse direct factorization.",
        "Iterative solve with relative residual tolerance 1e-8.",
        "Iterative solve with relative residual tolerance 1e-4."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
